en: 3. Āyatanayamaka 3.1 Paṇṇattivāra 3.1.2.
Exposition of the Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāraniddesa)
3.1.2.1. Chapter on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanavāra) 3.1.2.1.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma) Is the eye the eye-base (cakkhāyatana)?
The divine eye, the wisdom-eye, and the eye are not the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*). The eye-base is both the eye and the eye-base.
Is the eye-base the eye? Yes.
Is the ear the ear-base?
The divine ear is the stream of craving, not the ear-base. The ear-base is both the ear and the ear-base.
Is the ear-base the ear? Yes.
Is the nose the nose-base? Yes.
Is the nose-base the nose? Yes.
Is the tongue the tongue-base? Yes.
Is the tongue-base the tongue? Yes.
Is the body the body-base?
With the exception of the body-base, the remainder of the body is not the body-base. The body-base is both the body and the body-base.
Is the body-base the body? Yes.
Is form the sphere of form?
With the exception of the sphere of form, the remainder of form is not the sphere of form; the sphere of form is both form and the sphere of form.
Is the sphere of form form? Yes.
Sound is the sound-base? Yes. Is the sound-base sound? Yes.
Is odor the odor-base? Yes.

The fragrance of virtue, the fragrance of concentration, and the fragrance of wisdom are fragrances, but they are not the fragrance base (*gandhāyatana*). The fragrance base is both a fragrance and the fragrance base.
Is the fragrance base a fragrance? Yes.
Is taste the taste base (*rasāyatana*)?
The taste of the Dhamma, the taste of liberation, and the taste of the noble life are "taste," but they are not the taste-base (*rasāyatana*). The taste-base is both "taste" and the "taste-base.
Is the taste-base "taste"? Yes.
Is the tangible object the "tangible-object-base" (*phoṭṭhabbāyatana*)? Yes.
Is the sphere of the tangible the tangible? Yes.
Is the mind the mind-sphere? Yes. Is the mind-sphere the mind? Yes.
Is *dhamma* the *dhammāyatana*?
With the exception of the *dhammāyatana*, all remaining *dhamma* is not the *dhammāyatana*. The *dhammāyatana* is both *dhamma* and the *dhammāyatana*.
Is the *dhammāyatana* *dhamma*? Yes.
3.1.2.1.2. Negative (Paccanīka) Is it not the eye, and not the eye-base? Yes.
Is it not the eye-base, and not the eye? Yes.
The divine eye and the wisdom-eye are not the eye-base, but they are the eye. Excluding both the eye and the eye-base, the remainder is neither the eye nor the eye-base.
Is it not the ear and not the ear-base? Yes. Is it not the ear-base and not the ear? Yes.
The divine ear is not the ear-base; it is the ear. Excluding both the ear and the ear-base, the remainder is neither the ear nor the ear-base.
Is it not the nose and not the nose-base? Yes.
Is it not the nose-base and not the nose? Yes.
Is it not the tongue, and not the tongue-base? Yes.
Is it not the tongue-base, and not the tongue? Yes.
Is it not the body, and not the body-base? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not the body-base (kāyāyatana) is not the body (kāya)?
With the exception of the body-base, the remainder is not the body-base, but is the body. With the exception of both the body and the body-base, the remainder is neither the body nor the body-base.
Is it not the case that what is not form (rūpa) is not the form-base (rūpāyatana)? Yes, it is.
Is it not the case that the visible-form base is not visible form?

With the exception of the visible-form base, the remainder is not the visible-form base, but it is visible form. With the exception of both visible form and the visible-form base, the remainder is neither visible form nor the visible-form base.
Is it not the case that sound is not the sound base? Yes, it is.
Is it not the case that the sound-base is not sound? Yes.
Is it not the case that fragrance is not the fragrance-base? Yes. Is it not the case that the fragrance-base is not fragrance? Yes.

The fragrance of virtue, the fragrance of concentration, and the fragrance of wisdom are not the fragrance base (gandhāyatana), yet they are fragrance. Excluding both fragrance and the fragrance base, the remainder is neither fragrance nor the fragrance base.
Is it not the case that it is neither taste (rasa) nor the taste base (rasāyatana)? Yes. Is it not the case that it is neither the taste base nor taste? Yes.

The taste of the Dhamma, the taste of the Dhamma, and the taste of liberation are not the taste-base, yet they are tastes. Excluding both taste and the taste-base, the remainder is neither taste nor the taste-base.
Is it not the case that what is not tangible is not the tangible-base? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not the tangible-base is not tangible? Yes.
Is it not the mind, and not the mind-base? Yes.
Is it not the mind-base, and not the mind? Yes.
Is it not the mental object, and not the mental-object-base? Yes.
Is it not the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) and yet not a phenomenon (dhamma)?

With the exception of the base of mental phenomena, the remainder is not the base of mental phenomena, but it is a phenomenon. With the exception of both the phenomenon and the base of mental phenomena, the remainder is neither a phenomenon nor the base of mental phenomena.
3.1.2.2. The Wheel-Section Based on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanamūlacakkavāra)
3.1.2.2.1. Positive (Anuloma) Is the eye the eye-base?
The divine eye and the wisdom-eye are eyes, but not the eye-base. The eye-base is both an eye and the eye-base.
Is a base (āyatana) an ear-base (sotāyatana)?
The ear-base is both a base and an ear-base. The remaining bases are bases but not ear-bases.
Is the eye the eye-base?
The divine eye, the wisdom-eye, and the eye are not the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*). The eye-base is both the eye and the eye-base.
Are the bases the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*)? …pe… Are the bases the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*)?
The mental-object base is both a base and the mental-object base. The remaining bases are bases but not the mental-object base.
Is the ear the ear-base? ... [etc. ... The remaining bases are not the mind-object base.
... Is the mind-object the mind-object base?
With the exception of the mind-object base, the remaining mind-object is not the mind-object base. The mind-object base is both the mind-object and the mind-object base.
Are bases (āyatana) eye-bases (cakkhāyatana)?
The eye-base is both a base and an eye-base. The remaining bases are bases but not eye-bases.
Is the mental object (dhamma) the mind-object-base (dhammāyatana)?

With the exception of the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana), the remaining phenomena are phenomena but not the base of mental phenomena. The base of mental phenomena is both a phenomenon and the base of mental phenomena.
Are the bases the ear-base (sotāyatana)? … [and so on] … Are the bases the mind-base (manāyatana)?
The mind-base is both a base and the mind-base; the remaining bases are bases but not the mind-base.
(The wheel based on a single term should be constructed by one who is not confused. 3.1.2.2.2.
Negative (Paccanīka):
Is it the case that "it is not the eye, and it is not the eye-base"? Yes, it is.
Are they not bases (āyatana) and yet not the ear-base (sotāyatana)? Yes.
Are they not the eye and yet not the eye-base (cakkhāyatana)? Yes.
Are they not bases and yet not the nose-base (ghānāyatana)? Yes. … [and so on] …
Are they not bases (āyatana) and yet not the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana)?
Yes. Are they not the ear and yet not the ear-base (sotāyatana)?
Yes. Are they not bases and yet not the eye-base (cakkhāyatana)? ... [and so on] ... Are they not bases and yet not the base of mental phenomena? Yes.
Is it not the nose, nor the nose-base? ... [and so on] ...
Are they not bases, nor the mental-object-base?
Yes. ... [and so on] ...
Is it not the case that what is not *dhamma* is not the *dhammāyatana*? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not a *āyatana* is not the *cakkhāyatana*? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not *dhamma* is not the *dhammāyatana*? Yes.
Are they not bases, yet not the ear-base? ... [and so on] ... Are they not bases, yet not the mind-base? Yes.
(When forming the cycle, "Yes" should be stated for all instances.
3.1.2.3. Chapter on Pure Bases.
3.1.2.3.1. In the direct order:
Is it the eye base? Yes.
Are bases the eye base? No.
The eye-base is both a base and the eye-base. The remaining bases are bases but not the eye-base.
Is the ear a base?
Yes. … [and so on for] the nose … the tongue … the body … visible form … sound … odor … flavor … tangible object … the mind …
Is the Dhamma a base (āyatana)? Yes.
Are all bases the Dhamma-base (dhammāyatana)? The Dhamma-base is both a base and the Dhamma-base; the remaining bases are bases but not the Dhamma-base.
3.1.2.3.2. Negative (Paccanīka) Is it not the eye, yet not a base?
With the exception of the eye, the remaining bases are not the eye, but they are bases. With the exception of both the eye and the bases, the remainder are neither the eye nor the bases.
Are they not bases, yet not the eye-base? Yes.
Are they not the ear, yet not a base?
[They are not] except for the ear …pe… except for the nose …pe… except for the tongue …pe… and they are not bases.
Are they bases but not the tongue-base? Yes.
Is it not the body [base] but not a base? Yes.
Are they bases but not the body-base? Yes.
Is it not form and not a base?
[It is] excluding form …pe… excluding sound …pe… excluding odor …pe… excluding taste …pe… excluding tangible object …pe… and yet not a base.
Are they not bases and not the tangible-object base? Yes.
Is it not mind, yet not a base?
With the exception of mind, the remaining bases are not mind, but they are bases. With the exception of both mind and base, the remainder are neither mind nor base.
Is it not a base, yet not the mind-base? Yes.
Is it not the case that "it is not dhamma" implies "it is not an āyatana"? Yes.
Is it not the case that "it is not an āyatana" implies "it is not the dhammāyatana"? Yes.
3.1.2.4. The Wheel-Section Rooted in the Pure Āyatanas.
3.1.2.4.1. In direct order:
Is the eye a base (āyatana)? Yes.
Are bases the ear-base? No.
The ear-base is both a base and the ear-base. The remaining bases are bases but not the ear-base.
Is the eye a base? Yes.
Are the [remaining] bases the nose-base … [and so on] … are the bases the mind-object-base? Yes.
The sphere of mental objects (dhammāyatana) is both a sphere and the sphere of mental objects. The remaining spheres are spheres but not the sphere of mental objects.

Is the ear a sphere? Yes. Are spheres the eye-sphere? ... [as before] ... They are not the eye-sphere. ... [as before] ... Are spheres the sphere of mental objects? ... [as before] ... They are not the sphere of mental objects.
Is the nose a base? Yes.
Are bases the eye-base? … [and so on] … Are bases the mind-object-base? … [and so on] … It is not the mind-object-base … [and so on] ….
Is the mental phenomenon a base? Yes.
Are the bases the eye-base …pe… are the bases the mind-base?
The mind-base is both a base and the mind-base. The remaining bases are bases but not the mind-base.
(The wheel should be constructed.)
3.1.2.4.2. Negative (Paccanīka) Is it not the eye, and yet not a base?
With the exception of the eye, the remaining bases are not the eye, but they are bases. With the exception of both the eye and the bases, the remainder are neither the eye nor bases.
Is it not the case that they are bases but not the ear-base? Yes.
Is it not the case that the eye is not a base?
With the exception of the eye, the remaining bases are not the eye, yet they are bases. With the exception of both the eye and the bases, the remainder are neither the eye nor bases.
Are they not bases and not the nose-base …pe… are they not bases and not the mental-object-base? Yes.
Is the ear not a base?
[It is] excluding the ear …pe… excluding the nose …pe… excluding the tongue …pe… and yet it is not a base.
Are they not bases (āyatana) and yet not the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana)?
Yes. Is it not the body and yet not a base? Yes.
Are they not bases and yet not the eye-base (cakkhāyatana)? Yes. … [and so on] … Are they not bases and yet not the base of mental phenomena? Yes. … [and so on] …
Is it not the case that "dhamma" is not a base (āyatana)? Yes.
Are bases not the eye-base (cakkhāyatana)? Yes.
Is it not the case that "dhamma" is not a base? Yes.
Are they not bases, yet not the ear-base? Yes.
… [and so on] … Are they not bases, yet not the mind-base? Yes.
(The wheel should be completed.)
The Section on the Exposition of Designations.
